raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

`InternVLChatModel._parse_and_validate_video_input` pops `image_embeds`:

```python
video_embeds = kwargs.pop("image_embeds", None)
```

`image_embeds` belongs to the image modality. When a request carries image
embeddings and a video together, the video parser reads those embeddings, matches
the `video_embeds is not None` branch, and returns early with
`InternVLVideoEmbeddingInputs` wrapping the image data. The video is never
processed, and the caller gets image embeddings under the video modality with no
error.

Both inputs are reachable at once: `image_embeds` and `pixel_values_flat_video`
are declared fields, and `_parse_and_validate_multimodal_inputs` dispatches to the
image and video parsers from the same kwargs, so whichever key appears first in
the request does not stop the other branch running.

Pop `video_embeds` instead, which is the key the video modality owns.

This does not add video-embedding support to InternVL. `video_embeds` is not in
`_get_video_fields_config`, so the branch stays inert; supporting it needs
`get_video_repl` to accept `num_patches=None` the way `get_image_repl` already
does, plus a frame count derived from the embedding shape. That is a separate
change.

### Duplicate-work check

No open PR or issue covers this. Searched open and closed PRs for `internvl`,
`internvl video_embeds`, and `video_embeds`. The nearest related change is #54633,
which fixed the same class of key-routing defect in MiniCPM-V.

## Test Plan

```bash
pytest tests/model_executor/test_internvl.py -v
pre-commit run --files vllm/model_executor/models/internvl.py \
    tests/model_executor/test_internvl.py
```

The test needs no GPU and no model weights.

## Test Result

```
1 passed
```

Reverting the fix fails it with
`AssertionError: assert 'video_embeds' == 'pixel_values_videos'`, which is the
video modality carrying the image payload.

pre-commit is clean, including `mypy-3.12` at the manual stage CI uses.

nodes.body: Hi @DarkLight1337, @Isotr0py. InternVL turns out to have the same `video_embeds` mix-up as #54633: the video parser pops `image_embeds`, so a request carrying an image embedding and a video quietly loses the video. Same one-line shape as last time. No codeowner on this path, so I'm tagging you directly. Mind taking a look? Thanks!

## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
Thanks, but let's remove the test

detail.title: [Bugfix][InternVL] Stop the video parser consuming image_embeds

files.patch:
@@ -755,7 +755,7 @@ def _parse_and_validate_video_input(
     ) -> InternVLVideoInputs | None:
         pixel_values_flat_video = kwargs.pop("pixel_values_flat_video", None)
         video_num_patches = kwargs.pop("video_num_patches", None)
-        video_embeds = kwargs.pop("image_embeds", None)
+        video_embeds = kwargs.pop("video_embeds", None)
 
         if pixel_values_flat_video is None and video_embeds is None:
             return None
